auth.authorizeHint: Credentials go directly to this service; the application never sees your password.

users.title: Users
users.phoneHint: Optional. Free-form — include the country code for international numbers.
users.empty: No users yet — create the first one.
users.initialPasswordHint: The user must change it at first sign-in.
users.resetHint: All of the user's sessions and tokens are revoked; they must change this password at next sign-in.
users.forceLogoutConfirm: Revoke every session and token for {{username}}? They will need to sign in again everywhere, including API scripts.
users.deleteConfirm: This permanently removes the user, their role assignments, and every token. This cannot be undone.

roles.title: Roles
roles.name: Name
roles.empty: No roles yet — create the first one.
roles.deleteConfirm: Users holding this role lose its permissions immediately. This cannot be undone.

oauth.title: OAuth
oauth.grantsDescription: Which agents can act as which user right now. Revoking cuts the client's access for that user — current tokens and future refreshes alike.
oauth.clientsDescription: Clients that self-registered via dynamic client registration. Registration is open by design; this list is your visibility into who has ever connected.
oauth.revokeConfirm: The client loses all access for this user: current access tokens and future refreshes die immediately. The user can re-authorize at any time.
oauth.grantsEmpty: No active grants — no agent is currently authorized.

profile.title: My profile
profile.infoDescription: Update your own display name and contact info. Leave email or phone blank to remove it.
profile.usernameHint: Your username is your stable sign-in identity — ask an administrator if it needs to change.
profile.passwordDescription: Changing your password signs out every other session — other browsers, devices, and API tokens included.

linkedAccounts.title: Linked accounts
linkedAccounts.description: External identities that can sign in as you. Linking never touches your password; a passwordless account cannot unlink its last credential.
linkedAccounts.lastCredentialHint: Last credential — set a password first
linkedAccounts.unlinkConfirm: You will not be able to sign in with this external account afterwards. You can link it again at any time.

linkErrors.already_linked: That external account is already linked to another account.
linkErrors.not_allowed: This account is not allowed to link external identities.
linkErrors.state_mismatch: The linking session expired or is invalid. Please try again.
